summary: Smoke/regression pass after import + 'build and run'. Backend boots with new .env; admin login (admin@travoo.in) works; 112 backend pytest cases passed (existing suites test_travoo_api, test_driver_documents, test_iter3/4/5 + new test_iter6_smoke), 1 skipped, 1 FAILED (forgot-password 500). Expo web bundles, language -> auth -> admin login -> all 5 tabs, search (Bengaluru->Chennai, 7 results), /driver page, AI and Manual verification screens all load. Admin dashboard CRASHED ('radius is not defined') because of a missing import - fixed by tester, now renders. Driver verification is functionally BROKEN for new drivers: the new AI/Manual screens use placeholder upload buttons (set state to 'temp_fid', no picker/upload), so submit always fails with 'Please upload: profile, licence, rc, vehicle photo'; AI OCR throws uncaught tesseract.js errors (red overlay). Since driver.tsx no longer renders DocPhotos for unsubmitted drivers, a new user cannot get verified from the UI and so cannot publish rides. No deprecated packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) detected.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error for any EXISTING email. RCA: inside forgot_password() the email text is assigned to a local named `body`, shadowing the request model, then `send_email(body.email, ...)` -> AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'email'. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:315 and :329

SECURITY: once the shadowing bug is fixed, when SMTP isn't configured (SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASSWORD not in .env -> send_email returns False) the endpoint returns `reset_token` in the response = anyone can reset any account (incl. admin) by knowing the email. Also reset token is make_token(user_id) = the same 7-day session JWT (no purpose claim, not single-use), and reset-password accepts ANY valid session JWT. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:310, :336-338, :350

minor.issue: Accepts empty OCR text and creates/updates a driver_documents record even when nothing was extracted (frontend sends it after tesseract failures).
Search results show leftover 'TEST Silk Board' trips and 'TEST_drv' earnings from earlier test iterations to real users (admin overview + search).

ui_bugs.issue: Crashed with 'radius is not defined' (radius used at lines 490/562 but not imported). FIXED by tester by adding radius to the ui import.
Same missing `radius` import at line 147 (OCR results card) - FIXED by tester.

Upload buttons are placeholders: onPress={() => setX('temp_fid')}; no image picker, nothing uploaded to POST /api/driver/documents/{kind}. Submit -> 400 'Please upload: profile, licence, rc, vehicle photo'. New drivers cannot complete verification.

Same placeholder uploads; 'Process with AI OCR' runs tesseract.js on the string 'temp_fid' -> 3x uncaught 'Error attempting to read image' (Expo red error overlay), then still POSTs empty text to /driver/ocr-verification and shows 'OCR Results'. Also successive setF({...f, ...}) calls overwrite each other (stale closure) so only the last extracted field is kept.
'View Details' pushes `/users/${id}` but the route is app/user/[id].tsx -> unmatched route.
Ionicons name 'mail-check' does not exist (renders '?'). Use e.g. 'mail-open' / 'checkmark-circle'.

integration_issues.issue: driver.tsx only offers AI/Manual buttons for unsubmitted drivers (DocPhotos uploader removed from that state); both sub-screens never upload photos, so /driver/verification always 400s. Offer tab stays at 'Get verified to publish rides' forever for new users (backend flow itself works - verified by pytest).

issues: Travoo logo is overlapped/clipped by the shield icon button at 390px width.
No testIDs on any upload buttons, fields or submit buttons.

react_native_issues.issue: tesseract.js 7 is a web-worker/browser library; it will not work in a native React Native/Expo Go runtime. Move OCR to backend (e.g. LLM vision via Emergent key) or a native OCR module. Reference: /app/frontend/src/utils/ocr.ts:1

CRITICAL: Fix AI OCR: don't run tesseract on placeholder strings; catch worker errors; preferably do OCR server-side (tesseract.js won't run on native). Fix stale setF updates (use one merged setF(prev => ({...prev, ...extracted}))).
